name: gcd-arcade
description: GCD-ARCADE — a PS3/PSP XMB-style retro launcher + live-view aggregator for German Car Depot's internal software.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:bff && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n bff,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:web"
